text:
maria_cs: Hey team — seeing a spike in tool failures for `payment_tool` over the last 3 hours. ~140 errors across 3 customers. Error: "schema validation failed: missing required field 'amount'". Repro steps pasted below.

sam_eng: Oof. Can you paste one raw model->tool payload + the system/fewshot prompts used? Also which model+version?

maria_cs: Model: `redwood/gpt-jt-4o:2026-03-10` (hosted). Root system prompt recently updated to include a few-shot example for an unrelated billing tool. Full payload (redacted):
```json
{"model_call_response":" {\"tool\": \"payment_tool\", \"args\": {\"currency\": \"USD\", \"description\": \"charge for order 123\"} }"}
```
Note: the `amount` field is missing, but `payment_tool` docs expect `amount` numeric. Looks like the model started emitting the example from the other tool that omits amount.

ajay_ml: That sounds like prompt shadowing / few-shot bleed. If the system example showed a call to `billing_lookup` with no amount, the model might generalize the shape. Did we add a new example last deploy?

maria_cs: Yes — product requested an extra example earlier today to demonstrate optional metadata. It was added to the system prompt bundle at 10:04 UTC. Errors started ~10:20 UTC.

tyler_oncall: @sam_eng can you check router logs for model variant rollouts or any fallback? Also add schema validation at the API layer for a fast mitigation.

sam_eng: I'm pulling the router traces now. Found that traffic was routed to the new prompt bundle variant (variant id pb-2026-03-10-v2). Confirmed 87% of failing calls hit that variant.

sam_eng: Quick mitigation deployed: api gateway now enforces a JSON schema for `payment_tool` args and returns a 400 with a clear message instead of forwarding malformed payloads to downstream. Deployed via canary at 11:05 UTC.

maria_cs: Thanks. Customers still saw some broken flows because the client code assumed success. We're opening support tickets. Any permanent fix suggestions?

ajay_ml: Permanent fix: remove the ambiguous few-shot example from the system prompt and add a targeted example for `payment_tool` that includes required fields. Also: add unit/eval tests that assert the tool call includes `amount` for payment flows. I can add a probe to Redwood Evals to catch schema drift.

sam_eng: Agreed. Also add a model-side instruction: surround tool calls with a strict wrapper template, e.g.:
```
CALL_TOOL: {
  "tool": "payment_tool",
  "args": {
    "amount": <NUMBER>,
    "currency": <STRING>,
    ...
  }
}
```
That reduces free-form examples.

maria_cs: For immediate customer communication, I'm sending an incident summary and the workaround (API schema guards + recommend reverting to previous prompt bundle).

tyler_oncall: I'll own the rollback of the system prompt example after ajay uploads the eval that flags this. @deploy-bot can you queue a rollback to pb-2026-03-10-v1?

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollback to prompt-bundle pb-2026-03-10-v1. Estimated time: 6m. :hourglass: (links: https://deploys.redwood.local/deploy/4321)

payment-tool-bot: Notifying downstream: payment service will reject malformed calls until gateway guards are in place. Contact: payments-team@redwood.com

maria_cs: After rollback and the gateway validation, errors dropped to baseline within 12 minutes. Closing the immediate escalation but keeping a postmortem and adding eval coverage. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
